question_en:
I am writing a guide for the school's Photography and Cultural Heritage Exhibition. The attachment features an award-winning entry from an international photography competition. Please answer the following questions:

1. What are the title and photographer of the work in the image? In which edition of which competition did it win an award?

2. Among all international award-winning works in that edition, which one depicts the following scene: a house situated on a high rocky cliff by the water, with a lighthouse standing nearby? Please provide the work title and photographer.

3. As of June 1, 2026, among the works by the photographer identified in Question 2 submitted to the same competition, which are black-and-white photographs? Please provide the relevant work titles, names of the photographed buildings, the year the buildings were originally completed, and the Commons pageid.

Answer Format: For Question 1, provide the work title, photographer, competition name, and edition in text. For Question 2, provide the work title and photographer in text. For Question 3, list the work title, name of the photographed building, year originally completed, and Commons pageid in a table; for works without a building, record the building name and completion year as "Not applicable".
answer:
Question 1: Work: Central Hall of Antwerp Central Station, Belgium, July 2022.jpg; Photographer: T meltzer; Competition: Wiki Loves Monuments; Edition: 2023.

Question 2: Work: Split Rock Light Station.jpg; Photographer: MichaelDPhotos.

Question 3:
